rateMethod: Monthly average or fixed-peg currency-rate multipliers to USD. Converted USD amount = PO Total Amount * exchangeRatesToUSD[YYYY-MM][currency].
sources: Federal Reserve G.5 monthly average rates for CAD, EUR, and GBP through June 2026. CAD was inverted from Canadian dollars per 1 USD. EUR and GBP are published as USD per currency unit.
Bank of Canada July 2026 monthly averages for CAD, EUR, and GBP, converted to USD through the July 2026 CAD per USD rate.
Central Bank of UAE USD/AED peg used for AED.
Saudi riyal fixed USD peg used for SAR.
Central Bank of Oman fixed RO/USD peg used for OMR.
notes: Use SEL Finance-approved rates if those differ from public monthly average rates.
AED, SAR, and OMR are treated as fixed peg rates for all displayed months.
Rows with currencies not included here should be flagged as conversion exceptions by the update agent.
